title: NRCS Soil Survey Geographic Database (SSURGO)
query:
SELECT p.mupolygonkey,p.mukey,m.musym,m.muname,l.areasymbol,l.areaname,
 p.mupolygongeo.STAsText() AS wkt
 FROM mupolygon p INNER JOIN mapunit m ON p.mukey=m.mukey
 INNER JOIN legend l ON m.lkey=l.lkey
 WHERE p.mupolygonkey IN (SELECT mupolygonkey FROM SDA_Get_Mupolygonkey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POLYGON ((-121.835 37.537, -121.835 37.612, -121.881 37.612, -121.881 37.537, -121.835 37.537))'))
